name: Hentai Punch!
source:
The story revolves around 18 years old delinquent who has his sights set on honorable ambitions: to become the world's greatest delinquent and get laid with as many girls he can, but unexpected news forces him to return to his hometown and face new challenges.

Enter the Seirin High, it's a local high school full of beautiful babes to which our protagonist enrolls, but unfortunately for him, this place is far from an ordinary academic institution and peaceful life here is not an option.

---

Further development of the game has been abandoned.
translation:
故事讲述了18岁的少年少年怀揣着光荣的抱负：成为世界上最伟大的少年，和尽可能多的女孩上床，但意想不到的消息迫使他回到家乡，面临新的挑战。

进入成林高中，这是我们的主角就读的一所当地的高中，里面充满了美丽的女孩，但不幸的是，对他来说，这个地方远离普通的学术机构，在这里平静的生活是不可能的。

---

游戏的进一步开发已被放弃。
